messages.content: Explain why a binary search algorithm needs sorted input. Keep the answer concise.

target_answer: Binary search works by repeatedly discarding half of the search range. That only works when the input is sorted, because the algorithm uses the middle value to decide whether the target must be on the left or the right. If the input is unsorted, that comparison no longer guarantees where the target could be.

messages.content: 把英文句子 "Break the ice" 翻译成中文，并解释它的常见含义。

target_answer: 可以翻译为“打破僵局”或“活跃气氛”。它通常不是字面上的打碎冰块，而是指在陌生、尴尬或沉默的场合里，通过一句话、一个话题或一个小活动让交流变得自然起来。
